versionNote: THE SINGLE VERSION CLAIMANT. Before v20 this app declared its version in FIVE places that disagreed (source/09 said v12, standings/data.js said v6.0, circuits.html said v19.1, README.md said v11, and the ledger row said v11). The footer stamp is written from THIS value by chrome.js, so there is one number and it is here. Do not hand-type a version anywhere else in the app; add a pointer instead.
